title: Newhalo reservation step
description: The first step of a reservation flow on a window-tall black screen: a wordmark beside a dark breadcrumb pill of steps, a 64px amber-to-red question that sweeps in on load, a short paragraph, three square dark choice cards with radio rings (the picked one gets an orange ring), and a 'next' button pinned to the bottom that lights up orange once something is picked. A tall art column fills the right on desktop.
notes: sized by the window (min-h-svh); it has its own small header, so leave newhalo-header off this page
no JavaScript: the button wakes up with :has(:checked)
